author: Matthew Adam
title: Gabriel Arias Pops Solo Shot, But Guardians Fall Short
desc: Gabriel Arias went 1-for-3 in Monday's 6-3 loss to the Rangers with a home run, a run scored and one RBI.
impact: Arias launched a solo shot in the fifth inning to tie the game at 1-1. Through 20 games, he's batting .217 with three homers, six RBI, four runs scored and a 26:2 K:BB (41.3% strikeout rate) across 60 at-bats.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Brayan Rocchio swipes a bag in loss
desc: Brayan Rocchio went 2-for-5 in a 6-3 loss to the Rangers with a run scored and a stolen base.
impact: Rocchio continues to provide solid fantasy production. After Monday's loss to Texas, Rocchio is slashing .271/.343/.386 with five home runs, 34 RBI, 33 runs scored, and 14 stolen bases across 82 games. He's hitting .290 with two steals over his past seven games.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Parker Messick's no-walk effort still ends in defeat
desc: Parker Messick allowed four earned runs on eight hits and no walks while striking out five over 6.2 innings in Monday's 6-3 loss to the Rangers.
impact: Messick was efficient enough to skip the free passes and only allowed two runs through the first six innings of the game before a two-run seventh chased him. After the defeat, he now has a 2.85 ERA and 1.06 WHIP with a 7-5 record and 106 strikeouts across 17 starts. His next start will be Saturday against the White Sox.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Victor Caratini Chips In With Key Blast In 5-4 Win
desc: Victor Caratini went 1-for-2 in a win over the Astros with a home run, two walks, one run scored, and one RBI.
impact: Caratini continues to do just enough to keep his bat relevant from behind the dish. After Monday's win, Caratini is slashing .241/.336/.379 with seven home runs, 32 RBI, and 20 runs scored across 62 games. He's been hot over his past 15 games, hitting .333 with four homers and 10 RBI over that span.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Josh Bell Blasts Clutch Homer in 5-4 Win
desc: Josh Bell went 1-for-4 in a win over the Astros with a home run, one run scored, and two RBI.
impact: Bell's two-run blast in the sixth inning pushed the Twins' lead to 4-1 and gave the team some breathing room. After Monday's win, Bell is batting .243 with 10 home runs, 53 RBI, 42 runs scored, and one stolen base across 83 games. He has been hot of late, hitting .314 with three homers and 14 RBI over his past 15 contests.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Luke Keaschall chips in hit, walk and swipe in tight win
desc: Luke Keaschall went 1-for-3 in a win over the Astros with a walk, one run scored, and one stolen base.
impact: Keaschall kept things modest but useful while helping Minnesota scrape by. After Monday's win over Houston, Keaschall is slashing .245/.329/.318 with two home runs, 12 stolen bases, and a .294 wOBA across 80 games.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Royce Lewis Goes Deep as Twins Edge Astros 5-4
desc: Royce Lewis went 1-for-4 in a win over the Astros with a home run, a run scored, one RBI, and two strikeouts.
impact: Lewis was responsible for the first run of the game with his solo homer in the fourth inning. After Monday's win, Lewis is hitting .214 over 52 games with eight home runs, 23 RBI, 22 runs scored, and five stolen bases, alongside a .294 wOBA and a .258 BABIP. Lewis has been hitting well of late, batting .276 over his past seven contests.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Yoendrys Gomez earns save on Monday
desc: Yoendrys Gomez got the final out of a 5-4 win over the Astros to earn a save on Monday.
impact: Gomez made things interesting as he allowed the Astros to come within one run by allowing a solo homer to Cam Smith before getting Joey Loperfido to ground out to preserve the win. Gomez is now a perfect nine-for-nine on save chances this season as he has emerged as the Twins' primary closer after opening the season with the Tampa Bay Rays.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Zebby Matthews grinds out seven strong in 89 pitches
desc: Zebby Matthews allowed one earned run on four hits and one walk while striking out seven over seven innings in Monday's 5-4 win over the Astros.
impact: Matthews turned in his best start of the season for the Twins on the way to picking up the win. After the win, he now owns a 4.15 ERA and 1.14 WHIP with a 4-5 record and 46 strikeouts across nine starts. Matthews will be back on the mound on Sunday against the Yankees.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Welinton Herrera (elbow) to undergo Tommy John surgery
desc: Welinton Herrera will undergo season-ending Tommy John surgery.
impact: Herrera, the Colorado Rockies' No. 14 prospect, was initially placed on the injured list with elbow inflammation before an MRI revealed a tear. He could undergo surgery as early as July 1 and is expected to miss at least the first half of the 2027 season. He closed the 2026 season without allowing a run over 2.1 innings with the Rockies, while posting a 5.16 ERA and 1.72 WHIP across 22.2 innings with Triple-A Albuquerque.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Jaden Hill (shoulder) yet to begin throwing
desc: Jaden Hill has been completing rehab exercises but has yet to resume throwing.
impact: Hill landed on the injured list June 24 due to right shoulder tendinitis. He is still in the early stages of recovery and has not yet resumed throwing. A clear timeline remains unavailable, and fantasy managers should not expect one until he begins a throwing progression.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Clay Holmes (fibula) to throw off mound this week
desc: Clay Holmes has been throwing on flat ground and hopes to throw off the mound sometime this week.
impact: Holmes fractured his right fibula on a comebacker May 15. He began throwing just over two weeks ago and has made steady progress in his recovery. However, fantasy managers should not expect him to return until August.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Blake Dunn (elbow) receives cortisone injection
desc: Blake Dunn received a cortisone injection.
impact: Dunn landed on the 10-day injured list June 28 with a right elbow sprain. He is expected to rest briefly before beginning a hitting and throwing progression. He remains without a clear timeline for return.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Patrick Sandoval (biceps) to make next rehab start Saturday
desc: Patrick Sandoval is scheduled to make his next minor league rehab start on Saturday.
impact: Sandoval last pitched on Sunday with Triple-A Worcester, allowing one run on three hits over four innings. His scheduled rehab start on Saturday could be his final outing before joining the Boston Red Sox rotation.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Nick Pivetta (elbow) throws light bullpen session Saturday
desc: Nick Pivetta threw a light bullpen session on Saturday.
impact: Pivetta has been sidelined since April 14 with a flexor strain. He began playing catch in late May and has since completed his first bullpen session. He will need multiple bullpen sessions and will likely face live hitters before beginning a minor league rehab assignment. Fantasy managers should not expect him to return before the All-Star break.
